| [124](#erc4626exitbook-124) | Grants the admin role to every caller that places an exit request, so any requester can take over the book.<br>Caught by: [`acEeOnlyRoleAdminMovesRoles`](../../specs/Erc4626ExitBook_LinkedVaultCore/Erc4626ExitBook_LinkedVaultCore_properties.spec#L1300) |
| [125](#erc4626exitbook-125) | Indexes a new request under its payout asset instead of its owner.<br>Caught by: [`eeZeroOwnerNoIds`](../../specs/Erc4626ExitBook_LinkedVaultCore/Erc4626ExitBook_LinkedVaultCore_valid_state.spec#L211) |
| [126](#erc4626exitbook-126) | Treats an adminless book as an open door: once the admin role is empty, the next account to cancel a request grants it to itself.<br>Caught by: [`acEeOnlyRoleAdminMovesRoles`](../../specs/Erc4626ExitBook_LinkedVaultCore/Erc4626ExitBook_LinkedVaultCore_properties.spec#L1300) |

```diff
--- a/src/periphery/Erc4626ExitBook.sol
+++ b/src/periphery/Erc4626ExitBook.sol
@@ -76,7 +76,7 @@
         if (assets == 0) revert ZeroAssets();

         uint256 requiredShares = vault.previewWithdraw(assets);
-        if (vault.allowance(msg.sender, address(this)) < requiredShares || vault.balanceOf(msg.sender) < requiredShares)
+        if (vault.allowance(msg.sender, address(this)) <= requiredShares || vault.balanceOf(msg.sender) < requiredShares)
         revert InsufficientBacking();

```

```diff
         if (fillAssets == 0) revert ZeroAssets();
```

```diff
--- a/src/periphery/ExitBookBase.sol
+++ b/src/periphery/ExitBookBase.sol
@@ -194,7 +194,7 @@
         if (fillAssets == 0) revert ZeroAssets();

         if (fillAssets > request.assetsRemaining) revert FillExceedsRemaining(fillAssets, request.assetsRemaining);
-        if (fillAssets < request.minFillAssets && fillAssets < request.assetsRemaining) {
```
